focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业需加速碳数据合规
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征收阶段。近期欧盟委员会发布过渡期最终报告要求，强调进口商须提交嵌入排放数据的完整性与可核查性。中国钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥等行业出口企业面临碳成本传导压力，需尽快建立产品级碳足迹核算体系，并关注欧盟认可的核查机构名录。建议企业提前与欧盟进口商对接数据格式，避免2027年后因数据缺失导致默认值惩罚。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会CBAM过渡期报告 · 2026.11.23
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Accelerate Carbon Data Compliance
focus.summary_en: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with the definitive regime starting in 2027. The European Commission's final transitional report stresses that importers must submit complete and verifiable embedded emissions data. Chinese exporters in steel, aluminium, cement, and fertilisers face carbon cost pass-through pressure and should establish product-level carbon footprint accounting and monitor the list of EU-accredited verifiers. Companies are advised to align data formats with EU importers early to avoid default-value penalties after 2027.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission CBAM Transitional Report · 2026.11.23

case.title: 新加坡高等法院承认中国法院商事判决，跨境债权追索路径进一步拓宽
case.summary: 近期新加坡高等法院依据《选择法院协议公约》及普通法规则，在一起中资企业诉新加坡公司合同纠纷中承认并执行了中国内地法院的生效判决。该案明确：若双方协议选择中国法院管辖且判决符合新加坡公共政策，新加坡法院可予以承认。对于出海企业而言，此案提示在跨境合同中明确约定管辖法院并保留完整送达与程序记录，可显著提升判决在普通法国家的可执行性。建议在东南亚业务合同中优先考虑加入新加坡或中国法院管辖条款。
case.source: 来源：新加坡高等法院判例综述 · 2026.11
case.title_en: Singapore High Court Recognises Chinese Commercial Judgment, Broadening Cross-Border Debt Recovery
case.summary_en: The Singapore High Court recently recognised and enforced a final civil judgment from mainland China in a contractual dispute between a Chinese company and a Singaporean entity, relying on the Hague Choice of Court Convention and common law principles. The decision clarifies that Singapore courts may recognise Chinese judgments where parties have agreed to Chinese court jurisdiction and the judgment is not contrary to Singapore public policy. For outbound companies, this underscores the importance of clear jurisdiction clauses and robust service and procedural records to enhance enforceability in common law jurisdictions. Including Singapore or Chinese court jurisdiction clauses in Southeast Asian contracts is advisable.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore High Court Case Digest · 2026.11

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地，涉外企业数据出境需完成安全评估
policy.summary: 广东省近日发布粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施，明确在湾区内特定行业（如金融、医疗、跨境电商）开展数据跨境流动试点，但涉及重要数据或个人信息出境的，仍须通过安全评估或订立标准合同。新规简化了港澳与内地间数据流动的申报流程，并设立湾区数据跨境服务中心提供合规咨询。建议大湾区涉外企业梳理数据资产，区分重要数据与一般数据，对涉及个人信息出境的场景优先采用标准合同备案，并利用服务中心资源降低合规成本。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026.11
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area: Foreign-Related Firms Must Complete Security Assessments
policy.summary_en: Guangdong Province has issued facilitation measures for cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area (GBA), launching pilot schemes in specific sectors such as finance, healthcare, and cross-border e-commerce. However, transfers involving important data or personal information still require security assessments or standard contractual clauses. The new rules streamline filing procedures between Hong Kong, Macao, and the mainland and establish a GBA data cross-border service centre for compliance advice. GBA foreign-related enterprises should map data assets, distinguish important from general data, prioritise standard contract filing for personal information transfers, and leverage the service centre to reduce compliance costs.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · 2026.11

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中企赴美技术合作需重构交易架构
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部近期拟将半导体、人工智能、量子计算等领域的对外投资审查范围扩展至更多交易类型，包括合资与绿地投资。中国出海企业在美开展技术合作、设立研发中心或参与基金投资时，可能触发申报义务。建议企业立即梳理涉美技术合作项目，评估是否落入新规覆盖范围；在交易文件中加入监管审批先决条件与分手费条款；对敏感技术领域考虑替代性合作模式（如许可而非股权），并提前与专业顾问设计申报策略，以降低交易不确定性。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部投资安全办公室 · 2026.11
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanded US Outbound Investment Review Requires Chinese Firms to Restructure US Tech Deals
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury is reportedly expanding outbound investment screening to cover more transaction types in semiconductors, AI, and quantum computing, including joint ventures and greenfield investments. Chinese companies pursuing technology cooperation, R&D centres, or fund investments in the US may trigger filing obligations. Companies should immediately map US-related tech projects to assess whether they fall within the new rules; incorporate regulatory approval conditions and break fees into transaction documents; consider alternative cooperation models (e.g., licensing instead of equity) in sensitive sectors; and engage professional advisers early to design filing strategies and reduce deal uncertainty.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Treasury Office of Investment Security · 2026.11
